title: Degree of a monomial derivative
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $S$ be a subset of the $n$ coordinates, and let $y$ be a point of the Boolean cube over the two-element field. The algebraic degree of the Boolean derivative in direction $y$ of the monomial on $S$ is at most $|S|-1$, with subtraction taken in the natural numbers.
